description: FORGE '26: India's Biggest Gen AI Buildathon by NxtWave Launchpad · Exclusively for IITs, NITs, IIITs & BITS 48 hours. Your team. Gen AI. Something real. Rewards worth ₹2,00,000+ 1st prize: ₹50,000 2nd prize: ₹30,000 ️ Audience Favourite: ₹20,000 Campus Champions: ₹3,000 for the top team from every college with 40+ valid unique team submissions At a glance 30 Oct, 7:30 PM → 1 Nov, 11:59 PM IST Online : build from anywhere Teams of 2–3 48-hour build sprint 2 tracks , themes revealed at kickoff Students from IITs, NITs, IIITs & BITS Free to participate Why you should join Ship a real Gen AI project for your resume and portfolio in one weekend. Test yourself against the sharpest builders from India's top engineering campuses. Everyone starts level: the track themes are revealed only at kickoff. Rally your campus: if 40+ teams from your college submit, your top team wins the Campus Champions reward. How to register Complete your registration on Launchpad: https://tinyurl.com/Forge-Unstop-registrationCreate your team there, or join with your teammate's team code. This step is mandatory. Be ready for kickoff on 30 Oct, 7:30 PM IST . Registrations close on 30 Oct at 7:30 PM IST. Don't wait for the last hour. Who can participate: students currently enrolled at any of the IITs, NITs, IIITs and BITS campuses, in teams of 2–3.

raw.details:
FORGE '26: India's Biggest Gen AI Buildathon by NxtWave Launchpad · Exclusively for IITs, NITs, IIITs & BITS

48 hours. Your team. Gen AI. Something real.

Rewards worth ₹2,00,000+

  • 1st prize: ₹50,000
  • 2nd prize: ₹30,000
  • ️ Audience Favourite: ₹20,000
  • Campus Champions: ₹3,000 for the top team from every college with 40+ valid unique team submissions

At a glance

  • 30 Oct, 7:30 PM → 1 Nov, 11:59 PM IST
  • Online: build from anywhere
  • Teams of 2–3
  • 48-hour build sprint
  • 2 tracks, themes revealed at kickoff
  • Students from IITs, NITs, IIITs & BITS
  • Free to participate

Why you should join

  • Ship a real Gen AI project for your resume and portfolio in one weekend.
  • Test yourself against the sharpest builders from India's top engineering campuses.
  • Everyone starts level: the track themes are revealed only at kickoff.
  • Rally your campus: if 40+ teams from your college submit, your top team wins the Campus Champions reward.

How to register

  • Complete your registration on Launchpad:https://tinyurl.com/Forge-Unstop-registrationCreate your team there, or join with your teammate's team code. This step is mandatory.
  • Be ready for kickoff on 30 Oct, 7:30 PM IST.

Registrations close on 30 Oct at 7:30 PM IST. Don't wait for the last hour.

Who can participate: students currently enrolled at any of the IITs, NITs, IIITs and BITS campuses, in teams of 2–3.
